title: Shell Method for Region Between Line and Parabola
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Use the shell method to find the volume generated by revolving the region between y = 2x and y = x^2 about the y-axis.

steps.title: Find Intersection Points
steps.explanation: Curves intersect at x = 0 and x = 2.

steps.title: Determine Shell Height
steps.explanation: Height is top curve minus bottom curve.

steps.title: Integrate
steps.mathExpression: V = 2\pi \int_0^2 x(2x - x^2) dx = 2\pi \int_0^2 (2x^2 - x^3) dx = 2\pi \left[ \frac{2x^3}{3} - \frac{x^4}{4} \right]_0^2 = 2\pi \left( \frac{16}{3} - 4 \right) = 2\pi \left( \frac{4}{3} \right) = \frac{8\pi}{3}
